prompt: What are the "loudness wars" and what changes in technology might cause them to end?
response: The "loudness wars" refer to the competitive practice in the music industry of making each album louder than the last. This arms race can be attributed to advancements in compression technology that make it easier to increase loudness. However, these technologies will continue to evolve, so the loudness wars are unlikely to end anytime soon. In fact, the constant pursuit of loudness might become even more intense as technology progresses.
